correctness.rationale: The Abrams/Prue–Scrimshaw n=2 cubical model is applicable to the girth-six Heawood graph and is equivariantly included in configuration space. All 91/252/168 cells and integer boundaries were constructed, with boundary-square zero and one-skeleton rank 90. Eight explicit proper six-cycle lifts surject to graph H1 of dimension eight, bounding rank ∂2 above by 154; exact mod-3 rank 154 bounds rational rank below, so rational H1=8/H2=14. Degree-two integral homology is top kernel, hence Z^14. Every one of 336 automorphisms gives a signed cellular trace and an independent direct mod-101 kernel trace; all agree. Nine-class character inner products are 1,1,2 and yield two inequivalent absolutely irreducible 8- and 6-dimensional rational summands. Not a finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The Heawood (3,6)-cage, its Fano point-line duality and order-336 automorphism group are canonical geometric structures. Complete nine-class homology characters and the unexpected exceptional 6-dimensional module constitute a natural exact representation classification not implied by known graph two-particle Betti numbers, first-homology torsion, or generic generation by product cycles. The zero-invariant conclusion is a further structural feature. It is explicitly limited to this single motivated graph; does not pretend a general theorem.
